a_en: Any current employee designated by the responsible person; monitoring the facility remotely during Labor Standards Act working hours
b_en: Holding an environmental engineering degree and registered with the professional engineers association; on site at least three working days each week
c_en: Trained and certified by the central competent authority or an agency it commissions; stationed at the facility during Labor Standards Act working hours
d_en: Selected and appointed by the municipal or county authority; on site once each day during actual operating hours
explain_zh: 第2條第1項：專業技術人員應由經中央主管機關或其委任、委託、委辦其他機關（構）訓練合格，並取得合格證書者擔任。第3條：應於勞動基準法所定工作時間內常駐於設施機構；因故未能常駐者，應備有請假紀錄或其他相關證明文件以備查閱。第2條第2項：各類設施機構應設置之類別、等級及人數，依廢棄物清理法第28條第2項至第5項及第42條所定公告及管理辦法辦理。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-常駐規定
q_zh: 依規定設置之專業技術人員應如何常駐？未能常駐時應如何處理？
a_zh: 應於設施機構實際營運時間內每日到場二次；因故未能到場者，應由設施機構負責人代為簽章並作成書面紀錄
b_zh: 應於勞動基準法所定工作時間內以視訊方式監控；因故未能監控者，應於事後三日內補行現場查核並作成紀錄
c_zh: 應於勞動基準法所定工作時間內常駐於設施機構；因故未能常駐者，應備有請假紀錄或其他相關證明文件以備查閱
d_zh: 應於每月至少十五個工作日常駐於設施機構；因故未能常駐者，應報請主管機關核准後始得請假離開設施機構
q_en: How must the personnel be stationed, and what applies if they cannot be?
a_en: On site twice a day during the facility own actual operating hours; if absent, the responsible person signs on their behalf and makes a written record
b_en: Monitoring by video during Labor Standards Act working hours; if unable to monitor, an on-site check within three days afterwards
c_en: Stationed at the facility during Labor Standards Act working hours; if absent for cause, leave records or other supporting documents must be kept for inspection
d_en: Stationed at least fifteen working days a month; if unable to be present, prior approval from the competent authority is required
explain_zh: 第3條：依本法第28條第2項至第5項及第42條所定公告或管理辦法規定所設置之專業技術人員，應於勞動基準法所定工作時間內常駐於設施機構；因故未能常駐在設施機構者，應備有請假紀錄或其他相關證明文件，以備查閱。第2條並規定專業技術人員應由訓練合格並取得合格證書者擔任。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-業務內容
q_zh: 專業技術人員關於清理計畫書、許可申請、申報及紀錄書表文件之業務為何？
a_zh: 核發事業廢棄物清理計畫書、審查許可申請文件、核定定期監測報告、簽訂清除處理契約書、開立遞送聯單，並代主管機關辦理稽查及裁處作業
b_zh: 確認事業廢棄物清理計畫書、許可申請文件、定期監測報告、清除處理契約書、遞送聯單及營運紀錄並簽章，並確認書面或網路申報資料及配合稽查簽章
c_zh: 確認事業廢棄物清理計畫書及許可申請文件並簽章，其餘定期監測報告、契約書、遞送聯單及申報資料均應由設施機構負責人親自簽章確認
d_zh: 確認公司財務報表、勞工安全衛生紀錄、環境影響評估書件及土地登記謄本並簽章，並確認書面或網路申報資料及配合勞動檢查簽章
q_en: Regarding plans, permit applications, reporting and records, the personnel must:
a_en: Issue the waste disposal plan, review permit application documents, approve periodic monitoring reports, sign disposal contracts, issue manifests, and carry out inspections and impose penalties on behalf of the authority
b_en: Confirm and sign the waste disposal plan, permit application documents, periodic monitoring reports, disposal contracts, manifests and operating records; confirm written or online filings and sign off during inspections
c_en: Confirm only the disposal plan and permit application documents; all other reports, contracts, manifests and filings must be signed by the responsible person personally
d_en: Confirm financial statements, occupational safety records, EIA documents and land registry transcripts; confirm filings and sign off during labor inspections
explain_zh: 第4條第1款：專業技術人員應確認事業廢棄物清理計畫書、有關許可申請文件、定期監測報告（並監督或確認委託檢測機構之採樣）、廢棄物清除處理契約書內容不得違反本法規定、廢棄物遞送聯單及營運紀錄並簽章，確認書面或網路申報資料，並配合主管機關或目的事業主管機關稽查並確認簽章。第4條第2款另定設備設施操作及管理事項，包括擬定緊急應變措施、作成保養維護紀錄、主動以書面向事業報告違法情形及改善建議。
explain_en: Article 4, subparagraph 1 (and subparagraph 2 on facility operation).

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-離職異動
q_zh: 設置於設施機構之專業技術人員離職或異動時，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應於離職或異動日起七日內以網路傳輸方式報請中央主管機關備查；但設施機構已先行公開於資訊網路者，不在此限
b_zh: 應於離職或異動日前六十日內以書面報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查；但已另行指定代理人者，得免報請備查
c_zh: 應於離職或異動日起三十日內以書面報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關核准；但設施機構已依規定報請核准者，不在此限
d_zh: 應於離職或異動日起十五日內以書面報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查；但設施機構已依規定報請備查者，不在此限
q_en: When personnel leave or are reassigned, they must:
a_en: File online with the central competent authority within 7 days, unless the facility has published it online
b_en: File in writing within the 60 days before departure, unless a deputy has been designated
c_en: Obtain written approval from the competent or industry competent authority within 30 days of the departure or change, unless the facility has already done so
d_en: File in writing with the competent or industry competent authority within 15 days of the departure or change, unless the facility has already filed
explain_zh: 第5條：設置於設施機構之專業技術人員離職或異動時，專業技術人員應於離職或異動日起十五日內以書面報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查；但設施機構已依規定報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查者，不在此限。第6條另定代理人之指定規定。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-代理規定
q_zh: 應取得自行處理許可文件之事業及甲級廢棄物處理機構，其專業技術人員之代理規定為何？
a_zh: 專業技術人員離職或異動時應指定取得次一等級以上合格證書之人員代理；非因離職異動而因故未能執行業務連續三十日以上時，應指定具任一等級訓練資格之人員代理
b_zh: 專業技術人員離職或異動時應指定取得同一等級以上合格證書之人員代理；非因離職異動而因故未能執行業務連續十五日以上時，應指定具同一等級以上訓練資格之人員代理
c_zh: 專業技術人員離職或異動時應指定取得同一等級以上合格證書之人員代理；非因離職異動而因故未能執行業務連續三日以上時，應指定該設施機構之負責人或主管代理
d_zh: 專業技術人員離職或異動時應由主管機關指派同一等級以上人員代理；非因離職異動而因故未能執行業務連續九十日以上時，應指定具乙級以上訓練資格之人員代理
q_en: For enterprises needing self-treatment permits and Class A treatment organizations, deputies must be:
a_en: On departure or change, someone certified one grade lower or above; when duties cannot be performed for 30 consecutive days for other reasons, someone with any grade of training qualification
b_en: On departure or change, someone certified at the same grade or above; when duties cannot be performed for 15 consecutive days for other reasons, someone with same-grade-or-above training qualifications
c_en: On departure, someone certified at the same grade or above; for other absences of 3 consecutive days, the facility's responsible person or a supervisor
d_en: On departure, a person assigned by the competent authority at the same grade or above; for other absences of 90 consecutive days, someone with Class B or above training
explain_zh: 第6條第1項：依廢棄物清理法第28條第2項及第42條所定應取得自行處理許可文件之事業及甲級廢棄物處理機構，其應設置之專業技術人員離職或異動時，應指定取得同一等級以上合格證書之專業技術人員代理。第6條第2項：非因離職、異動而因故未能執行業務連續十五日以上時，設施機構應指定具同一等級以上專業技術人員訓練資格之人員代理。第6條第3項：指定代理人報請備查依相關公告或管理辦法辦理。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-到職訓練
q_zh: 專業技術人員於何種情形應完成到職訓練？其期限及報請備查規定為何？
a_zh: 於到職前連續一年以上未經依法設置或登記為專業技術人員者，應於到職之翌日起三個月內完成到職訓練；設施機構應於該期間屆滿之日起三十日內檢具證明文件報請備查
b_zh: 於到職前連續五年以上未經依法設置或登記為專業技術人員者，應於到職之翌日起一年內完成到職訓練；設施機構應於該期間屆滿之日起七日內檢具證明文件報請核准
c_zh: 於到職前連續三年以上未經依法設置或登記為專業技術人員者，應於到職之前六個月內完成到職訓練；設施機構應於其到職之日起六十日內檢具證明文件報請備查
d_zh: 於到職前連續三年以上未經依法設置或登記為專業技術人員者，應於到職之翌日起六個月內完成到職訓練；設施機構應於該期間屆滿之日起十五日內檢具證明文件報請備查
q_en: On-the-job training is required when, and within what deadlines?
a_en: Where the person has not been registered as such personnel for one consecutive year before starting; training completed within three months from the day after starting; the facility files proof within 30 days of that period ending
b_en: Where not registered for five consecutive years; training within one year; the facility seeks approval within 7 days
c_en: Where not registered for three consecutive years; training completed in the six months before starting; the facility files proof within 60 days of starting
d_en: Where the person has not been registered as such personnel for three consecutive years before starting; training completed within six months from the day after starting; the facility files proof within 15 days of that period ending
explain_zh: 第7條第1項：設置於設施機構之專業技術人員，於到職前連續三年以上未經依法設置或登記為專業技術人員者，應於到職之翌日起六個月內，依中央主管機關規定完成到職訓練。第7條第2項：完成到職訓練後，設施機構應於前項期間屆滿之日起十五日內，檢具完成到職訓練證明文件報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
category: 廢清技術人員-在職訓練與廢止
q_zh: 未依規定完成到職訓練並報請備查者之效果，以及在職訓練之規定為何？
a_zh: 主管機關應註銷其合格證書且終身不得再受訓，設施機構亦應同時停業改善；在職訓練得由設施機構自行辦理並自行核發時數證明即可
b_zh: 主管機關得暫緩核發該機構許可證，設施機構應於一年內完成補正；專業技術人員參加在職訓練前須先經設施機構書面同意始得報名
c_zh: 主管機關應處以罰鍰並令限期補行訓練，設施機構得繼續使用該人員執行業務；專業技術人員參加在職訓練應自行負擔費用並利用休假期間為之
d_zh: 主管機關應廢止其專業技術人員之設置，設施機構應辦理專業技術人員之變更或異動；專業技術人員應參加在職訓練，設施機構不得以任何方式妨礙或禁止
q_en: Failure to complete and file on-the-job training results in what, and what governs in-service training?
a_en: Cancellation of the certificate with a lifetime training ban and suspension of the facility; in-service training may be run by the facility itself
b_en: The authority may withhold the facility's permit pending correction within one year; personnel need the facility's written consent to enroll in training
c_en: A fine and an order to complete the training later, while the person keeps working; personnel must pay for in-service training themselves and attend it during their own annual leave
d_en: The authority annuls the personnel appointment and the facility must process a change or replacement; personnel must attend in-service training and the facility may not obstruct or prohibit it
explain_zh: 第7條第3項：未依規定完成到職訓練並報請主管機關或目的事業主管機關備查者，主管機關或目的事業主管機關應廢止其專業技術人員之設置，設施機構應依規定辦理專業技術人員之變更或異動。第8條：專業技術人員應參加中央主管機關或其委任、委託、委辦其他機關（構）辦理之在職訓練，設施機構不得以任何方式妨礙或禁止。

law: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法
q_zh: 廢棄物清理專業技術人員管理辦法之施行日期規定為何？
a_zh: 本辦法自發布日施行，未另定其他施行日期
b_zh: 本辦法自發布後一年施行，並溯及既往而適用
c_zh: 本辦法自發布後三個月施行，並定有過渡條款
d_zh: 本辦法自中央主管機關另行公告之日起施行之
q_en: The effective date rule of these Regulations is:
a_en: They take effect on the date of promulgation, with no separate date set
b_en: They take effect one year after promulgation and apply retroactively
c_en: They take effect three months after promulgation, with transitional rules
d_en: They take effect on a date separately announced by the central authority
explain_zh: 第9條：本辦法自發布日施行。本辦法最近一次修正日期為民國一百十一年十一月二十九日，並未另定施行日期，故修正條文自發布日生效。

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 《一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法》之訂定法源依據為何？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十五條第二項規定訂定之
b_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第三十九條第二項規定訂定
c_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十二條第一項規定訂定之
d_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第十二條第一項規定訂定
q_en: Under which provision are these Regulations enacted?
a_en: Enacted under Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
c_en: Enacted under Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
d_en: Enacted under Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Resource Recycling Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法（本法）第十二條第一項規定訂定之。本法第十五條第二項為應回收廢棄物之公告依據，第三十九條第二項則為事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法之授權依據，兩者均非本辦法之法源。
explain_en: Article 1 cites Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act as the enabling provision.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 依本辦法第2條，「有害垃圾」之定義為何？
a_zh: 指經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關公告具毒性之一般事業廢棄物
b_zh: 指被拋棄之生、熟食物殘渣或經公告之有機性一般廢棄物
c_zh: 指符合有害事業廢棄物認定標準並經中央主管機關公告之一般廢棄物
d_zh: 指體積龐大之廢棄傢俱或修剪庭院之樹枝等一般廢棄物
q_en: Under Article 2, how is hazardous garbage defined?
a_en: General industrial waste announced as toxic in nature by the municipal or county (city) competent authority of its location
b_en: Discarded raw or cooked food and its residues, or organic general waste announced by the competent authority
c_en: General waste meeting the hazardous industrial waste identification standards and announced by the central competent authority
d_en: General waste of large volume such as discarded furniture or branches trimmed from a garden or courtyard
explain_zh: 第2條第3款：有害垃圾指符合有害事業廢棄物認定標準並經中央主管機關公告之一般廢棄物。同條第1款巨大垃圾為體積龐大之廢棄傢俱、修剪庭院之樹枝；第4款廚餘為被拋棄之生、熟食物及其殘渣或經公告之有機性一般廢棄物。第32條並規定有害垃圾採封閉掩埋處理者，準用事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準。
explain_en: Article 2(3) defines hazardous garbage; subparagraphs 1 and 4 define bulky garbage and kitchen waste respectively.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之清理過程，應具備何種設備或措施？
a_zh: 應具有防止廢棄物飛散、濺漏、溢漏、洩漏及污染環境之設備或措施
b_zh: 應具有防止噪音、振動及惡臭超過管制標準之污染防制設施
c_zh: 應具有防止廢棄物遭竊、遺失及混雜其他事業廢棄物之管制措施
d_zh: 應具有即時追蹤定位、自動計量及影像辨識之全程監控設備
q_en: What equipment or measures must be provided during the clearance and disposal of general waste?
a_en: Equipment or measures preventing scattering, splashing, overflow, leakage and environmental pollution
b_en: Pollution control facilities preventing noise, vibration and odour from exceeding control standards
c_en: Control measures preventing theft, loss and the mixing of waste with other industrial waste
d_en: Full-process monitoring equipment for real-time tracking, automatic weighing and image recognition
explain_zh: 第3條：一般廢棄物之清理過程應具有防止廢棄物飛散、濺漏、溢漏、洩漏及污染環境之設備或措施。第2條第14款並定義「清理」指一般廢棄物貯存、回收、清除或處理之行為，故本條適用於清理之各階段。
explain_en: Article 3 requires equipment or measures against scattering, splashing, overflow, leakage and pollution.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之處理具資源回收效益者，應由何人設置資源回收設施？
a_zh: 由當地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關編列預算統一設置
b_zh: 由廢棄物產生源之事業依目的事業主管機關規定設置
c_zh: 由執行機關委託之清除機構依清理契約約定負責設置
d_zh: 由處理設施之所有者依主管機關規定設置資源回收設施
q_en: Who must install recycling facilities where general waste disposal has recycling benefits?
a_en: The local municipal or county (city) authority budgets for and installs them uniformly
b_en: The enterprise generating the waste installs them as prescribed by the industry authority
c_en: The clearance institution entrusted by the executing agency installs them under the contract
d_en: The owner of the disposal facility installs them as prescribed by the competent authority
explain_zh: 第4條：一般廢棄物之處理具資源回收效益者，處理設施之所有者應依主管機關規定，設置資源回收設施。責任主體為處理設施之所有者，而非產生源事業、受託清除機構或地方主管機關。
explain_en: Article 4 places the duty on the owner of the disposal facility.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物應依何種規定交付回收、清除或處理？
a_zh: 應依中央主管機關公告之分類標準及全國一致之收運時間交付
b_zh: 應依執行機關公告之分類、收集時間、指定地點與清運方式交付
c_zh: 應依受託清除機構自行排定之路線、時段及計價方式交付
d_zh: 應依產生源與清除機構議定之收集頻率及交付地點辦理
q_en: Under what rules must general waste be handed over for recycling, clearance or disposal?
a_en: Under the classification standards and nationwide uniform collection times announced by the central authority
b_en: Under the classification, collection times, designated places and clearance methods announced by the executing agency
c_en: Under the routes, time slots and pricing arranged by the entrusted clearance institution itself
d_en: Under the collection frequency and delivery places agreed between the source and the clearance institution
explain_zh: 第5條：一般廢棄物除依本辦法規定外，應依執行機關公告之分類、收集時間、指定地點與清運方式，交付回收、清除或處理。第14條並就巨大垃圾、資源垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘分別規定其交付方式。
explain_en: Article 5 requires compliance with the executing agency's announced classification, times, places and methods.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 家戶或其他產生源委託清除、處理一般廢棄物者，應委託何者辦理？
a_zh: 應委託經目的事業主管機關登記有案之合法運輸業者或回收處理業者
b_zh: 應委託取得再利用許可之再利用機構或事業廢棄物共同清理機構
c_zh: 應委託當地執行機關指定之社區資源回收站或民間回收商代為處理
d_zh: 應委託經主管機關許可清除、處理該類廢棄物之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構
q_en: Whom must a household or other source entrust with clearance and disposal of general waste?
a_en: A lawful transport operator or recycling enterprise registered with the industry competent authority
b_en: A reuse institution holding a reuse permit or a joint industrial waste clearance institution
c_en: A community recycling station or private collector designated by the local executing agency
d_en: A public or private waste clearance and disposal institution permitted by the authority for that waste type
explain_zh: 第6條第3項：家戶或其他產生源委託公民營廢棄物清除處理機構清除、處理一般廢棄物者，應委託經主管機關許可清除、處理該類廢棄物之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構。第6項並規定受託清除處理之機構準用本法第31條第1項第2款及第5項申報營運紀錄。
explain_en: Article 6, paragraph 3 requires entrusting only a permitted clearance and disposal institution for that waste type.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 建築物拆除之石綿瓦廢棄物，其分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應報經中央主管機關逐案核准後，依核准之清除處理計畫書內容辦理
b_zh: 應依有害事業廢棄物認定標準所定之封閉掩埋方式辦理，不得另行處理
c_zh: 應由執行機關比照巨大垃圾之清除方式辦理，並洽請排定時間予以排出
d_zh: 應依本辦法附件一所定之管理方式，辦理其分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理
q_en: How must asbestos-tile waste from building demolition be classified, stored, discharged, cleared and disposed of?
a_en: Under a clearance plan approved case by case in advance by the central competent authority
b_en: By closed landfill under the hazardous industrial waste identification standards, with no other option
c_en: By the executing agency in the same way as bulky garbage, with a discharge time arranged in advance
d_en: In accordance with the management method set out in Attachment 1 to these Regulations
explain_zh: 第6條之1：建築物拆除石綿瓦廢棄物之分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理，應依附件一之管理方式辦理。本條為石綿瓦廢棄物之特別管理規定，並非逕依巨大垃圾或有害事業廢棄物之一般規定辦理。
explain_en: Article 6-1 requires the management method in Attachment 1.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 受託清除、處理裝潢修繕廢棄物之網路申報，最早自何時、對何地區之產生源開始適用？
a_zh: 自一百十五年一月一日起，產生源位於臺北市、新北市及基隆市，受託者屬事業廢棄物共同清除機構等事業
b_zh: 自一百十四年三月一日起，產生源位於臺北市、新北市及桃園市，受託者屬公民營廢棄物處理機構等事業
c_zh: 自一百十六年七月一日起，產生源位於全國各直轄市，受託者屬公民營廢棄物處理機構及共同處理機構等事業
d_zh: 自一百十四年七月一日起，產生源位於臺中市、臺南市及高雄市，受託者屬公民營廢棄物清除機構等事業
q_en: From when and for which sources does online reporting of decoration and repair waste first apply?
a_en: From 1 January 2026, for sources in Taipei, New Taipei and Keelung, where the entrusted party is a joint industrial waste clearance institution and similar entities
b_en: From 1 March 2025, for sources in Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan, where the entrusted party is a public or private waste disposal institution and similar entities
c_en: From 1 July 2027, for sources in all special municipalities, where the entrusted party is a public or private waste disposal or joint disposal institution and similar entities
d_en: From 1 July 2025, for sources in Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung, where the entrusted party is a public or private waste clearance institution and similar entities
explain_zh: 第6條之2第1款：自一百十四年三月一日起，廢棄物產生源位於臺北市、新北市及桃園市，受託者屬公民營廢棄物處理機構、事業廢棄物共同處理機構及第六條第六項第三、四款之事業者，應網路申報。第2款自同年七月一日起適用清除機構；第3款自一百十五年七月一日起及第4款自一百十六年七月一日起逐步擴大地區。
explain_en: Article 6-2, subparagraph 1 sets 1 March 2025 for Taipei, New Taipei and Taoyuan with disposal-side entrusted parties.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之貯存應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 貯存設施應裝設即時影像監視系統，影像紀錄並應保存三個月以上
b_zh: 貯存地點應設置圍籬及門禁管制，並由專責人員每日簽到巡查並作成紀錄
c_zh: 貯存容器應以不透水材質構築，且每月至少更換或消毒清洗一次以上
d_zh: 貯存地點、容器、設施經常保持清潔完整，且不得有飛揚、逸散、滲出或惡臭
q_en: What requirements apply to the storage of general waste?
a_en: Storage facilities must have real-time video surveillance, with recordings kept for three months or more
b_en: Storage sites must have fencing and access control, with dedicated staff signing in and inspecting daily
c_en: Storage containers must be built of impermeable material and be replaced or disinfected monthly
d_en: Storage sites, containers and facilities are kept clean and intact, with no scattering, dispersal, seepage or odour
explain_zh: 第7條：一般廢棄物之貯存應符合貯存地點、容器、設施經常保持清潔完整，及不得有廢棄物飛揚、逸散、滲出、污染地面或散發惡臭情事等二款規定。第8條至第11條則分別就資源垃圾貯存場所、貯存設施及戶外貯存容器另設加重規定。
explain_en: Article 7 requires cleanliness and the absence of scattering, dispersal, seepage or odour.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 資源垃圾回收貯存場所除一般貯存規定外，尚應符合何項規定？
a_zh: 貯存設施應依收受日期先後分別貯存，並以顏色區分其貯存之期限
b_zh: 貯存場所應依廢棄物代碼分區堆置，並以英文及中文雙語標示其成分
c_zh: 貯存容器應依產生源之行政區別分別貯存，並以編號及條碼標示其來源
d_zh: 貯存容器、設施依所存放之資源垃圾種類分別貯存，並以中文標示其種類
q_en: What further requirements apply to a recyclable waste storage site beyond the general storage rules?
a_en: Facilities store recyclables separately by date of receipt, with colours distinguishing storage periods
b_en: The site stacks recyclables in zones by waste code, with contents marked in both English and Chinese
c_en: Containers store recyclables separately by administrative district of origin, marked by number and barcode
d_en: Containers and facilities store recyclables separately by type, with the type marked in Chinese
explain_zh: 第8條：資源垃圾回收貯存場所除應符合第7條規定外，並應依所存放之資源垃圾種類分別貯存並以中文標示、將完成分類之資源垃圾置於分區貯存格、防止打包後之資源垃圾掉落倒塌崩塌，及於適當位置標示執行機關資源垃圾回收貯存場名稱及資源回收標誌。
explain_en: Article 8 requires separate storage by type with Chinese labelling, zoned bins, anti-collapse measures and site signage.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之貯存設施應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 設置防止地面水、雨水及地下水流入滲透之設備，並收集或防止廢液廢氣惡臭污染
b_zh: 設置抽水泵浦定期排除積水之設備，並將收集之廢液直接排入雨水下水道系統
c_zh: 設置地下水監測井及自動採樣設備，並每月將監測結果報請主管機關備查
d_zh: 設置自動噴灑除臭藥劑之設備，並將產生之廢氣經稀釋後由高煙囪排放至大氣
q_en: What requirements apply to storage facilities for general waste?
a_en: Equipment preventing surface water, rainwater and groundwater from entering, plus collection or prevention of liquid, gas and odour pollution
b_en: Pumps to periodically remove accumulated water, with the collected waste liquid discharged directly into the public storm sewer system
c_en: Groundwater monitoring wells and automatic sampling equipment, with monthly results filed with the authority
d_en: Automatic deodorant spraying equipment, with the resulting waste gas diluted and released through a tall stack
explain_zh: 第9條：一般廢棄物之貯存設施應設置防止地面水、雨水及地下水流入、滲透之設備或措施，並就由貯存設施產生之廢液、廢氣、惡臭等，設置收集或防止其污染地面水體、地下水體、空氣、土壤之設備或措施。第10條就資源垃圾回收貯存場所之貯存設施另有加重規定。
explain_en: Article 9 requires water-intrusion prevention plus collection or prevention of waste liquid, gas and odour pollution.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 資源垃圾回收貯存場所之貯存設施，關於計量及紀錄之規定為何？
a_zh: 設置計量設備，並每季按資源垃圾用途分別記錄體積，紀錄應保存二年以供查核
b_zh: 設置計量設備，並每週按資源垃圾類別合併記錄重量，紀錄應保存三年以供查核
c_zh: 設置計量設備，並每日按資源垃圾類別分別記錄重量，紀錄應保存一年以供查核
d_zh: 設置監視設備，並每月按資源垃圾來源分別記錄件數，紀錄應保存五年以供查核
q_en: What weighing and record requirements apply to recyclable waste storage facilities?
a_en: Install weighing equipment, record the volume quarterly by use of recyclable waste, and keep the records for two years for inspection
b_en: Install weighing equipment, record the combined weight weekly by category of recyclable waste, and keep the records for three years
c_en: Install weighing equipment, record the weight daily by category of recyclable waste, and keep the records for one year for inspection
d_en: Install surveillance equipment, record item counts monthly by source of recyclable waste, and keep the records for five years
explain_zh: 第10條第2款：資源垃圾回收貯存場所之貯存設施應設置計量設備，並每日按資源垃圾類別分別記錄重量，紀錄保存一年以供查核。同條第1款規定回收之廢照明光源應貯存於堅固分區貯存設施或容器；第4款規定應設置必要之消防設施。
explain_en: Article 10, subparagraph 2 requires daily weight records by category, kept for one year.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之貯存容器置於戶外者，其設施應符合何項規定？
a_zh: 不洩漏污水、不發生腐敗臭味、可防止雨水滲入並可防止貓狗覓食
b_zh: 應以金屬材質構築、離地面五十公分以上，並設置獨立排水管線
c_zh: 應加裝上鎖裝置、設置監視器材，並標示容器所有人及聯絡電話
d_zh: 應每日清洗消毒一次、加蓋防塵網，並於夜間移入室內妥為保管
q_en: What requirements apply where general waste storage containers are placed outdoors?
a_en: No leakage of wastewater, no putrid odour, prevention of rainwater ingress and prevention of scavenging by cats and dogs
b_en: Construction from metal, placement at least fifty centimetres above the ground, and a separate drainage pipeline
c_en: Installation of locks and surveillance devices, with the container owner and a contact telephone number marked on it
d_en: Daily washing and disinfection, a dust cover net, and removal indoors for safekeeping during the night
explain_zh: 第11條：一般廢棄物之貯存容器置於戶外者，其設施應符合不洩漏污水、不發生腐敗臭味、可防止雨水滲入、可防止貓狗覓食之設備或措施、可配合一般廢棄物之清除作業，及其他經主管機關或執行機關規定者等六款規定。
explain_en: Article 11 lists no wastewater leakage, no putrid odour, rain prevention and scavenging prevention among the requirements.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 公共場所及營業場所設置之資源垃圾回收桶，其標示應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 正面標示廢棄物代碼及重量上限，依材質標示顏色區別，側面標示回收廠商聯絡方式
b_zh: 正面標示縣市徽章及環保宣導標語，依季節標示收運時段，側面標示清運人員姓名
c_zh: 正面標示執行機關全銜及回收專線，依容量標示重量上限，側面標示啟用日期及編號
d_zh: 正面標示資源回收標誌及資源回收桶字樣，依設置種類標示類別，側面標示設置單位名稱
q_en: How must recycling bins in public and business premises be labelled?
a_en: The front bears the waste code and weight limit, colours are marked by material, and the side bears the recycler's contact details
b_en: The front bears the city emblem and an environmental slogan, collection hours are marked by season, and the side bears the collector's name
c_en: The front bears the executing agency's full title and hotline, the weight limit is marked by capacity, and the side bears the start date and number
d_en: The front bears the recycling logo and the words recycling bin, the type is marked by bin category, and the side bears the installing unit's name
explain_zh: 第12條：執行機關設置或輔導公共場所及營業場所設置資源垃圾回收桶，其標示應於正面之適當位置標示資源回收標誌及「資源回收桶」字樣、依資源回收桶設置種類標示資源垃圾類別字樣，並於側面標示設置單位名稱。
explain_en: Article 12 requires the recycling logo and wording on the front, the category marking, and the installing unit's name on the side.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 執行機關應宣導民眾將一般廢棄物依何種方式排出？
a_zh: 廚餘應以廚餘機打碎排入下水道，尖銳利器應以舊報紙包覆丟棄，有害垃圾交清潔隊回收
b_zh: 廚餘先瀝除水分並妥為包裝，尖銳利器以不易穿透材質包妥標示，有害垃圾應分開排出
c_zh: 廚餘應先加入除臭劑冷藏保存，尖銳利器應以透明塑膠袋盛裝，有害垃圾併入一般垃圾
d_zh: 廚餘應先脫水乾燥並自行堆肥，尖銳利器應送交醫療院所代收，有害垃圾投入資源回收桶
q_en: How should the executing agency advise the public to discharge general waste?
a_en: Grind kitchen waste into the sewer, wrap sharp objects in old newspaper for disposal, and give hazardous garbage to the cleaning team
b_en: Drain and wrap kitchen waste, wrap and label sharp objects in puncture-resistant material, and discharge hazardous garbage separately
c_en: Refrigerate kitchen waste with deodorant added, place sharp objects in clear plastic bags, and mix hazardous garbage with general garbage
d_en: Dewater and compost kitchen waste at home, hand sharp objects to medical institutions, and place hazardous garbage in recycling bins
explain_zh: 第13條：執行機關應因地制宜宣導民眾將一般廢棄物依廚餘先瀝除水分並妥為包裝、刀片玻璃碎片等尖銳利器以不易穿透容器或材質包妥並標示、木竹片予以裁剪並綑紮、封緊垃圾袋袋口、有害垃圾應分開貯存排出、資源垃圾依回收管道分類貯存排出及回收等方式排出。
explain_en: Article 13 requires draining and wrapping kitchen waste, puncture-resistant wrapping of sharps, and separate discharge of hazardous garbage.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 巨大垃圾應以何種方式交付回收、清除或處理？
a_zh: 交付執行機關或受託機構之資源垃圾回收車回收，並於指定時間送至回收桶站
b_zh: 交付執行機關或受託機構之專用車輛清除，並應先行拆解為體積較小之零組件
c_zh: 洽請執行機關或受託機構安排時間排出，並應符合執行機關規定之清除處理方式
d_zh: 逕行投置於執行機關設置之一般垃圾貯存設備內，並於外包裝標示排出者姓名
q_en: How must bulky garbage be handed over for recycling, clearance or disposal?
a_en: Hand it to the recyclable waste collection vehicle of the agency or entrusted institution at the designated collection station
b_en: Hand it to the dedicated vehicle of the agency or entrusted institution after first dismantling it into smaller components
c_en: Arrange a discharge time with the executing agency or its entrusted institution, following the prescribed clearance method
d_en: Place it directly in the general garbage storage equipment set up by the executing agency, marked with the discharger's name
explain_zh: 第14條第1項第1款：巨大垃圾應洽請執行機關或執行機關委託之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構（受託機構）安排時間排出，並應符合執行機關規定之清除處理方式。同項第3款有害垃圾始為交付專用車輛清除；第2款資源垃圾始為交付資源垃圾回收車回收。
explain_en: Article 14, paragraph 1, subparagraph 1 requires arranging a discharge time with the agency or its entrusted institution.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 巨大垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘之清運機具應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 具備即時追蹤系統及自動計量設備並每日消毒，車體規格符合廢棄物清理法相關規定
b_zh: 具備密閉壓縮裝置及自動秤重設備並每季檢驗，車體規格符合噪音管制標準之規定
c_zh: 具備影像監視系統及氣體偵測裝置並每週保養，車體規格符合空氣污染防制法之規定
d_zh: 具備作業安全警示系統及防漏功能並經常清洗消毒，車體規格符合道路交通安全規則
q_en: What requirements apply to clearance vehicles for bulky, hazardous, general and kitchen waste?
a_en: Real-time tracking systems and automatic weighing equipment, daily disinfection, and body specifications meeting the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Sealed compaction devices and automatic weighing equipment, quarterly inspection, and body specifications meeting noise control standards
c_en: Video surveillance systems and gas detection devices, weekly maintenance, and body specifications meeting the Air Pollution Control Act
d_en: Necessary safety warning systems and leak prevention, frequent washing and disinfection, and body specifications meeting road traffic safety rules
explain_zh: 第15條：巨大垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘清運機具，應具備必要之作業安全警示系統及防漏功能並經常清洗、消毒以保持清潔，經常保養維持正常操作，且車輛之車體規格符合道路交通安全規則之規定。第18條並規定租用之車輛亦應符合本條規定。
explain_en: Article 15 requires safety warning systems, leak prevention, cleaning and compliance with road traffic safety rules.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 執行機關或受託機構之資源垃圾回收車應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 裝置舉伸或傾卸設備，車體標示資源回收標誌，並標示回收單位名稱、專線與回收項目
b_zh: 裝置即時追蹤及計量設備，車體標示廢棄物代碼，並標示回收處理業名稱與許可證字號
c_zh: 裝置壓縮或破碎設備，車體標示執行機關全銜，並標示車輛編號、載重上限與駕駛姓名
d_zh: 裝置冷藏或除臭設備，車體標示環保宣導圖樣，並標示收運路線、時段與聯絡之地址
q_en: What requirements apply to a recyclable waste collection vehicle?
a_en: Lifting or tipping equipment, the recycling logo on the body, and the collecting unit's name, hotline and collected items marked
b_en: Real-time tracking and weighing equipment, the waste code on the body, and the recycling enterprise's name and permit number marked
c_en: Compaction or crushing equipment, the executing agency's full title on the body, and the vehicle number, load limit and driver's name marked
d_en: Refrigeration or deodorizing equipment, an environmental graphic on the body, and the route, time slots and contact address marked
explain_zh: 第16條：資源垃圾回收車應裝置舉伸或傾卸設備、車體與車身應標示資源回收標誌、於適當位置標示回收單位名稱、回收服務專線與回收項目、具備必要之作業安全警示系統並經常清洗消毒、經常保養維持正常操作，且車體規格符合道路交通安全規則之規定。
explain_en: Article 16 requires lifting or tipping equipment, the recycling logo, and marking of the unit's name, hotline and items.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 執行機關之垃圾車應如何標示？密封式及框式垃圾車應具備何種安全警示系統？
a_zh: 應於車身標示資源回收標誌及專線；並具有固定式綠色指示燈及自動廣播系統
b_zh: 應於車身標示車輛編號及駕駛姓名；並具有間歇式藍色閃爍燈及倒車雷達裝置
c_zh: 應於車身標示機關全銜及車種名稱；並具有固定式黃色閃爍指示燈及廣播設備
d_zh: 應於車身標示執行區域及清運路線；並具有旋轉式紅色警示燈及蜂鳴警報裝置
q_en: How must an executing agency's garbage truck be marked, and what warning system must sealed and frame trucks carry?
a_en: The recycling logo and hotline on the body; a fixed green indicator light and an automatic broadcasting system
b_en: The vehicle number and driver's name on the body; an intermittent blue flashing light and a reversing radar device
c_en: The agency's full title and vehicle type on the body; a fixed yellow flashing indicator light and broadcasting equipment
d_en: The service area and clearance route on the body; a rotating red warning light and a buzzer alarm device
explain_zh: 第16條之1第1項：執行機關回收、清除一般廢棄物所使用之垃圾車，應於車身標示機關全銜及車種名稱，並就密封式、子母式、框式垃圾車分別規定應具備之投棄口、壓縮裝置或吊桿升降設備。第2項：密封式及框式垃圾車應具有固定式黃色閃爍指示燈及廣播設備之安全警示系統。
explain_en: Article 16-1 requires the agency title and vehicle type, plus a fixed yellow flashing light and broadcasting equipment.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 小型清掃機械使用證應向何機關申請？操作人員應遵守何種規定？
a_zh: 向所在地之鄉（鎮、市）公所申請並報備查；駕駛人應領有機車駕駛執照並接受八小時教育訓練
b_zh: 向所在地之公路監理機關申請並定期換發；駕駛人應領有小型車職業駕駛執照並通過體格檢查
c_zh: 向清掃作業所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請；駕駛人應領有小型車普通駕駛執照並隨身攜帶使用證
d_zh: 向中央主管機關指定之機構申請核發；駕駛人應領有大型車職業駕駛執照並隨身攜帶行車執照
q_en: To which authority is a small sweeping machine permit applied for, and what must the operator observe?
a_en: To the township or city office of the location for recordation; the driver holds a motorcycle licence and completes eight hours of training
b_en: To the local motor vehicle office with periodic renewal; the driver holds a professional light vehicle licence and passes a physical examination
c_en: To the municipal or county (city) authority where sweeping is carried out; the driver holds an ordinary light vehicle licence and carries the permit
d_en: To an institution designated by the central competent authority; the driver holds a professional heavy vehicle licence and carries the registration
explain_zh: 第16條之2第1項：小型清掃機械使用證，由執行機關或其委託執行道路清掃作業之廠商，向清掃作業所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請。第3項第1款：駕駛人應領有小型車普通駕駛執照，並隨身攜帶小型清掃機械使用證；第2款並要求設置適當交通管制設施導引車流。
explain_en: Article 16-2 requires application to the local authority where sweeping occurs and an ordinary light vehicle licence plus carrying the permit.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物轉運設施之操作紀錄應如何辦理？
a_zh: 轉運設施之操作應逐月記錄，紀錄並應保存三年以供查核
b_zh: 轉運設施之操作應逐批記錄，紀錄並應保存十年以供查核
c_zh: 轉運設施之操作應逐季記錄，紀錄並應保存五年以供查核
d_zh: 轉運設施之操作應逐日記錄，紀錄並應保存一年以供查核
q_en: How must operating records of a general waste transfer facility be kept?
a_en: Operations are recorded monthly and the records kept for three years for inspection
b_en: Operations are recorded per batch and the records kept for ten years for inspection
c_en: Operations are recorded quarterly and the records kept for five years for inspection
d_en: Operations are recorded daily and the records kept for one year for inspection
explain_zh: 第17條第5款：轉運設施之操作應逐日記錄，紀錄並保存一年供查核。同條並要求轉運設施內具備防止再次污染環境之防治設備、消毒設備、適當之災害防止及緊急應變措施，且轉運過程應保持設施內外之環境衛生。
explain_en: Article 17, subparagraph 5 requires daily records kept for one year.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 執行機關辦理一般廢棄物清除業務，其車輛機具不足時得如何處理？
a_zh: 得逕行商請鄰近縣市之執行機關支援，並由支援機關自行指派人員隨車運送
b_zh: 得租用合法運輸業之車輛協助清除，並應由租用之機關（構）派員隨車運送
c_zh: 得委託未取得許可之民間車行代為清運，並由該車行負責人隨車監督運送
d_zh: 得徵用轄內私人自用小貨車協助清運，並由車主自行負責清運過程之安全
q_en: What may an executing agency do when it lacks vehicles for general waste clearance?
a_en: Directly request support from executing agencies in neighbouring counties, which assign their own accompanying staff
b_en: Rent vehicles from a lawful transport operator, with the renting agency assigning staff to accompany each trip
c_en: Entrust an unlicensed private vehicle operator, whose responsible person supervises the transport on board
d_en: Requisition privately owned light trucks in the jurisdiction, with owners responsible for transport safety
explain_zh: 第18條第1項：執行機關或本法第11條第9款之管理機構辦理一般廢棄物清除業務，其車輛機具不足時，得租用合法運輸業之車輛協助清除一般廢棄物，並應由租用之機關（構）派員隨車運送。第2項：租用之車輛應符合第15條及第16條之規定。
explain_en: Article 18 allows renting lawful transport vehicles, with the renting agency's staff accompanying the transport.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之處理設施應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 具防火防爆結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採混凝土構築、周圍具防止噪音外洩之隔音牆面
b_zh: 具耐重載結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採塑膠襯裡構築、周圍具防止車輛進入之阻隔設施
c_zh: 具堅固基礎結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採抗蝕材料構築、周圍具防止地表水流入之設備
d_zh: 具防震隔震結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採不鏽鋼構築、周圍具防止動物侵入之圍籬設施
q_en: What requirements apply to general waste disposal facilities?
a_en: A fire and explosion resistant structure, concrete on waste-contact surfaces, and sound barriers preventing noise escaping
b_en: A heavy-load structure, plastic lining on waste-contact surfaces, and barriers preventing vehicles from entering the site
c_en: A solid foundation structure, corrosion-resistant material on waste-contact surfaces, and equipment preventing surface water inflow
d_en: An earthquake-isolating structure, stainless steel on waste-contact surfaces, and fencing preventing animals from entering
explain_zh: 第19條：一般廢棄物之處理設施應具堅固之基礎結構、設施與廢棄物接觸之表面採抗蝕材料構築、周圍具防止地表水流入之設備、具污染防治設備及防蝕措施，及其他經主管機關規定者。第20條至第31條各種處理方式之設施均應先符合本條規定。
explain_en: Article 19 requires a solid foundation, corrosion-resistant contact surfaces and surface-water inflow prevention.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物採破碎、分選及壓縮處理者，其設施尚應符合何種規定？
a_zh: 具備防止溢流及滲漏警報之功能，並具備防止蚊蠅、鼠類及惡臭孳生之設備或措施
b_zh: 具備防止及警示火災、爆炸之功能，並具備防止噪音、臭味及污水處理之設備或措施
c_zh: 具備自動停機及斷電保護之功能，並具備防止粉塵、輻射及廢氣排放之設備或措施
d_zh: 具備遠端遙控及影像監視之功能，並具備防止震動、油污及廢水回收之設備或措施
q_en: What further requirements apply to crushing, sorting and compaction facilities for general waste?
a_en: Functions to warn of overflow and seepage, plus equipment or measures against mosquitoes, flies, rodents and odour generation
b_en: Functions to prevent and warn of fire and explosion, plus equipment or measures against noise and odour and for wastewater treatment
c_en: Functions for automatic shutdown and power cut protection, plus equipment or measures against dust, radiation and waste gas emission
d_en: Functions for remote control and video monitoring, plus equipment or measures against vibration and oil and for wastewater recovery
explain_zh: 第20條：一般廢棄物採破碎、分選及壓縮處理者，其設施除應符合第19條規定外，並應具備防止及警示火災、爆炸之功能，及具備防止噪音、臭味及污水處理之設備或措施。
explain_en: Article 20 requires fire and explosion prevention and warning, plus noise, odour and wastewater controls.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 糞尿中間處理設施採生物化學處理者，應具備何種設備？
a_zh: 應具有投入、貯留、氧化處理及上澄液再處理之設備，並免設污泥處理設備
b_zh: 應具有投入、貯留、加藥、固液分離、中和及分離液處理之各項處理設備
c_zh: 應具有投入、脫水、乾燥、造粒、包裝及成品貯存之各項處理與貯存設備
d_zh: 應具有投入、貯留、消化處理、上澄液再處理、污泥處理及消毒之各項設備
q_en: What equipment must a night soil intermediate treatment facility using biochemical treatment have?
a_en: Equipment for feeding, storage, oxidation and supernatant re-treatment, with no sludge treatment equipment required
b_en: Equipment for feeding, storage, chemical dosing, solid-liquid separation, neutralization and separated liquid treatment
c_en: Equipment for feeding, dewatering, drying, granulation, packaging and finished product storage at the facility
d_en: Equipment for feeding, storage, digestion, supernatant re-treatment, sludge treatment and disinfection
explain_zh: 第21條第1款：糞尿中間處理設施採生物化學處理者，應具有投入、貯留、消化處理、上澄液再處理、污泥處理及消毒之設備。第2款採氧化處理者應具投入、貯留、氧化處理及上澄液再處理之設備；第3款採化學處理者應具投入、貯留、加藥、固液分離、中和、分離液處理及污泥處理之設備。
explain_en: Article 21, subparagraph 1 lists feeding, storage, digestion, supernatant re-treatment, sludge treatment and disinfection.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 糞尿利用為肥料或提供肥分者，須經何種處理方式？
a_zh: 須經高溫焚化處理、灰渣穩定化、固化包裝或其他符合規定之處理方式
b_zh: 須經充分醱酵腐熟處理、加溫處理、藥劑消毒處理或其他符合規定之處理方式
c_zh: 須經固液分離處理、逆滲透過濾、活性碳吸附或其他符合規定之處理方式
d_zh: 須經稀釋沉澱處理、曝氣消毒、離心脫水或其他符合規定之處理方式
q_en: What treatment is required where night soil is used as fertilizer or to supply nutrients?
a_en: High-temperature incineration, ash stabilization, solidification and packaging, or another prescribed treatment
b_en: Full fermentation and maturation, heating, chemical disinfection, or another treatment meeting the prescribed requirements
c_en: Solid-liquid separation, reverse osmosis filtration, activated carbon adsorption, or another prescribed treatment
d_en: Dilution and sedimentation, aeration disinfection, centrifugal dewatering, or another prescribed treatment
explain_zh: 第22條：糞尿利用為肥料或提供肥分者，須經充分醱酵腐熟處理、加溫處理、藥劑消毒處理或其他符合主管機關及目的事業主管機關規定之處理方式。第26條第2款並就施用農地之堆肥規定醱酵堆中心溫度及維持天數。
explain_en: Article 22 requires full fermentation and maturation, heating, chemical disinfection or another prescribed method.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 動物屍體之處理原則為何？
a_zh: 以掩埋處理為原則，必要時得採焚化或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
b_zh: 以堆肥處理為原則，必要時得採冷凍或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
c_zh: 以焚化處理為原則，必要時得採掩埋或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
d_zh: 以化製處理為原則，必要時得採海拋或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
q_en: What is the principle for disposing of animal carcasses?
a_en: Landfill in principle, with incineration or another prescribed method used where necessary
b_en: Composting in principle, with freezing or another prescribed method used where necessary
c_en: Incineration in principle, with landfill or another prescribed method used where necessary
d_en: Rendering in principle, with ocean dumping or another prescribed method where necessary
explain_zh: 第23條：動物屍體以焚化處理為原則，必要時得採掩埋或其他主管機關及目的事業主管機關規定之方式處理。焚化處理設施並應符合第19條及第24條之規定。
explain_en: Article 23 makes incineration the principle, with landfill or another prescribed method where necessary.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物焚化處理設施之燃燒氣體溫度及焚化底渣灼燒減量規定為何？
a_zh: 二次燃燒室出口燃燒氣體溫度一小時平均值不得低於攝氏七百五十度；連續燃燒式底渣灼燒減量在百分之十以下
b_zh: 二次燃燒室出口燃燒氣體溫度一小時平均值不得低於攝氏八百五十度；連續燃燒式底渣灼燒減量在百分之五以下
c_zh: 二次燃燒室出口燃燒氣體溫度一小時平均值不得低於攝氏九百五十度；分批填料式底渣灼燒減量在百分之三以下
d_zh: 二次燃燒室出口燃燒氣體溫度一小時平均值不得低於攝氏八百度；連續燃燒式底渣灼燒減量在百分之十五以下
q_en: What combustion gas temperature and bottom-ash ignition loss are required for general waste incineration facilities?
a_en: Hourly average combustion gas temperature at the secondary chamber outlet not below 750 C; ignition loss under 10% for continuous incinerators
b_en: Hourly average combustion gas temperature at the secondary chamber outlet not below 850 C; ignition loss under 5% for continuous incinerators
c_en: Hourly average combustion gas temperature at the secondary chamber outlet not below 950 C; ignition loss under 3% for batch-feed incinerators
d_en: Hourly average combustion gas temperature at the secondary chamber outlet not below 800 C; ignition loss under 15% for continuous incinerators
explain_zh: 第24條第3款：二次空氣注入口下游或二次燃燒室出口之燃燒氣體溫度一小時平均值不得低於攝氏八百五十度。第5款：焚化底渣之灼燒減量，連續燃燒式焚化處理設施在百分之五以下、分批填料式在百分之十以下。第4款並規定焚化飛灰及底渣應分開貯存收集。
explain_en: Article 24, subparagraphs 3 and 5: 850 C hourly average, and ignition loss below 5% (continuous) or 10% (batch-feed).

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物採焚化處理以外之熱處理法者，其設施應符合何項規定？
a_zh: 應符合第十九條及第二十四條全部各款有關焚化設施之規定，不得減省
b_zh: 應符合第二十條有關破碎分選設施及第二十六條堆肥設施之各項規定
c_zh: 應符合第二十九條有關衛生掩埋設施及第三十條掩埋作業之各項規定
d_zh: 應符合第十九條及第二十四條第一款、第二款、第六款、第七款之規定
q_en: Which provisions must facilities using thermal treatment other than incineration meet?
a_en: Article 19 and all subparagraphs of Article 24 on incineration facilities, with no reduction
b_en: Article 20 on crushing and sorting facilities and Article 26 on composting facilities
c_en: Article 29 on sanitary landfill facilities and Article 30 on landfill operations
d_en: Article 19 and Article 24, subparagraphs 1, 2, 6 and 7
explain_zh: 第25條：一般廢棄物採焚化處理以外之熱處理法處理者，其設施應符合第19條及第24條第1款（進料計量及檢查設備）、第2款（消防及臭氣處理設備、滲出水收集系統）、第6款（緊急應變處理裝置）、第7款（其他經主管機關規定者）之規定。第2條第15款並定義熱處理法包括焚化法、熱解法、熔融法等。
explain_en: Article 25 requires compliance with Article 19 and Article 24, subparagraphs 1, 2, 6 and 7.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物採堆肥處理，施用農地之堆肥其醱酵過程之溫度規定為何？
a_zh: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏二十度至四十度間，並最少三十天維持攝氏三十度以上
b_zh: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏四十五度至七十度間，並最少七天維持攝氏五十度以上
c_zh: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏六十度至九十度間，並最少十四天維持攝氏七十度以上
d_zh: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏三十度至五十度間，並最少三天維持攝氏四十度以上
q_en: What fermentation temperatures apply to compost from general waste applied to farmland?
a_en: The pile core temperature is kept between 20 C and 40 C, and at 30 C or above for at least thirty days
b_en: The pile core temperature is kept between 45 C and 70 C, and at 50 C or above for at least seven days
c_en: The pile core temperature is kept between 60 C and 90 C, and at 70 C or above for at least fourteen days
d_en: The pile core temperature is kept between 30 C and 50 C, and at 40 C or above for at least three days
explain_zh: 第26條第2款：施用農地之堆肥，除高速堆肥外，醱酵過程中醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏四十五度至七十度間，及最少七天維持攝氏五十度以上，並符合肥料管理法之規定。第3款：堆肥供作土壤改良或園藝植物栽培使用時，應防止土壤或地下水污染，並得不受前款限制。
explain_en: Article 26, subparagraph 2 requires 45 to 70 C with at least seven days at 50 C or above.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 飛灰處理後衍生物與底渣最終處置之戴奧辛及重金屬檢測頻率為何？相關紀錄保存幾年？
a_zh: 衍生物每季檢測一次，底渣最終處置每批檢測一次，管理資料及檢測報告應保存一年
b_zh: 衍生物每月檢測一次，底渣最終處置每半年檢測一次，管理資料及檢測報告應保存五年
c_zh: 衍生物每批檢測一次，底渣最終處置每季檢測一次，管理資料及檢測報告應保存三年
d_zh: 衍生物每年檢測一次，底渣最終處置每年檢測一次，管理資料及檢測報告應保存七年
q_en: How often must incineration residues be tested for dioxins and metals, and how long are the records kept?
a_en: Derivatives tested once per quarter, bottom ash for final disposal tested once per batch, and the records kept for one year
b_en: Derivatives tested once per month, bottom ash for final disposal tested twice per year, and the records kept for five years
c_en: Derivatives tested once per batch, bottom ash for final disposal tested once per quarter, and the records kept for three years
d_en: Derivatives tested once per year, bottom ash for final disposal tested once per year, and the records kept for seven years
explain_zh: 第27條第3項：飛灰處理後之衍生物應每批進行戴奧辛總毒性當量及重金屬毒性特性溶出程序檢測一次。第4項：底渣除再利用外，進行最終處置時應每季檢測一次，超標時應速採補救措施並於下季採樣前提報改善計畫。第5項：管理資料及檢測報告應作成紀錄並保存三年以備查核。
explain_en: Article 27, paragraphs 3 to 5 require per-batch testing of derivatives, quarterly testing of bottom ash, and three-year record retention.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 灰渣及其處理後衍生物之運作申報及清運機具有何規定？
a_zh: 應以網路傳輸方式向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申報，清運機具並應裝置即時追蹤系統
b_zh: 應以網路傳輸方式向目的事業主管機關申報，清運機具並應加裝車廂密閉監視系統
c_zh: 應以電子郵件方式向當地執行機關逐月通報，清運機具並應張貼灰渣運送專用標誌
d_zh: 應以書面方式向中央主管機關按季報備，清運機具並應加裝自動計量及秤重之設備
q_en: What reporting and vehicle requirements apply to incineration ash and its derivatives?
a_en: Report online to the municipal or county (city) competent authority, and fit clearance vehicles with a real-time tracking system
b_en: Report online to the industry competent authority, and fit clearance vehicles with a sealed compartment monitoring system
c_en: Report by email to the local executing agency each month, and display a dedicated ash transport marking on the vehicles
d_en: Report in writing to the central competent authority each quarter, and fit clearance vehicles with automatic weighing equipment
explain_zh: 第27條之1第1項：灰渣及其處理後衍生物之產出、貯存、清除、處理、再利用，應準用本法第31條第1項第2款規定，以網路傳輸方式向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申報。第2項：其清運機具應準用本法第31條第1項第3款規定，裝置即時追蹤系統並維持正常運作。
explain_en: Article 27-1 requires online reporting to the local authority and real-time tracking systems on clearance vehicles.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 得以安定掩埋法處理之一般廢棄物種類及終止使用時之覆蓋規定為何？
a_zh: 廢玻璃、廢陶瓷、廢磚瓦及石材碎片等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度五十公分以上砂質或泥質黏土
b_zh: 焚化飛灰、底渣及其衍生物等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度一百公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土
c_zh: 廚餘、廢食用油及廢照明光源等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度二十公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土
d_zh: 有害垃圾、廢電池及廢農藥容器等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度十五公分以上之砂質黏土層
q_en: Which general wastes may go to stabilized landfill, and what final cover applies?
a_en: Waste glass, ceramics, bricks and stone fragments; at least 50 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination of use
b_en: Incineration fly ash, bottom ash and their derivatives; at least 100 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination
c_en: Kitchen waste, waste cooking oil and waste lighting sources; at least 20 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination
d_en: Hazardous garbage, waste batteries and pesticide containers; at least 15 cm of a sandy clay layer upon termination
explain_zh: 第28條：一般廢棄物中之廢玻璃、廢陶瓷、廢磚瓦、石材碎片（塊）或經中央主管機關指定者，得以安定掩埋法處理；其設施除應符合第19條規定外，並應於入口處豎立標示牌、周圍設圍牆與防止飛散設備、設置防止地盤滑動沈陷措施及水土保持措施，終止使用時應覆蓋厚度五十公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土。
explain_en: Article 28 covers waste glass, ceramics, bricks and stone, with 50 cm of clay cover on termination.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物衛生掩埋場底層及周圍基礎之材質與厚度規定為何？
a_zh: 透水係數低於10-6公分／秒、厚度一百公分以上之砂質材料，或透水係數低於10-9公分／秒、厚度一公分以上之人造不透水材料
b_zh: 透水係數低於10-7公分／秒、厚度六十公分以上之黏土質材料，或透水係數低於10-10公分／秒、厚度零點二公分以上之人造不透水材料
c_zh: 透水係數低於10-5公分／秒、厚度三十公分以上之黏土質材料，或透水係數低於10-8公分／秒、厚度零點五公分以上之人造不透水材料
d_zh: 透水係數低於10-4公分／秒、厚度十五公分以上之皂土材料，或透水係數低於10-7公分／秒、厚度零點一公分以上之人造不透水材料
q_en: What base and side liner requirements apply to a sanitary landfill for general waste?
a_en: Sandy material with permeability below 10-6 cm/s and at least 100 cm thick, or artificial impermeable material below 10-9 cm/s and at least 1 cm thick
b_en: Clay-type material with permeability below 10-7 cm/s and at least 60 cm thick, or artificial impermeable material below 10-10 cm/s and at least 0.2 cm thick
c_en: Clay-type material with permeability below 10-5 cm/s and at least 30 cm thick, or artificial impermeable material below 10-8 cm/s and at least 0.5 cm thick
d_en: Bentonite material with permeability below 10-4 cm/s and at least 15 cm thick, or artificial impermeable material below 10-7 cm/s and at least 0.1 cm thick
explain_zh: 第29條第1項第4款規定底層及周圍應以透水係數低於10-7公分／秒、厚度六十公分以上之黏土質、皂土或同等阻水功能材料為基礎，或以透水係數低於10-10公分／秒、厚度零點二公分以上之人造不透水材料為基礎。同項第6款並要求依地下水流向於上下游各設置一口以上監測井。第3項另規定一百十年二月二十二日修正施行後新設之衛生掩埋場應兩者兼具。
explain_en: Article 29, paragraph 1, subparagraph 4 sets these liner specifications; subparagraph 6 also requires monitoring wells up and down gradient.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 衛生掩埋作業之每日覆土及終止使用時覆蓋厚度規定為何？
a_zh: 每日工作結束時覆蓋厚度十五公分以上之砂土並予以壓實；終止使用時覆蓋厚度五十公分以上之阻水材料
b_zh: 每日工作結束時覆蓋厚度五公分以上之砂土並予以壓實；終止使用時覆蓋厚度二十公分以上之阻水材料
c_zh: 每週工作結束時覆蓋厚度十五公分以上之砂土並予以壓實；終止使用時覆蓋厚度五十公分以上之阻水材料
d_zh: 每日工作結束時覆蓋厚度三十公分以上之砂土並予以壓實；終止使用時覆蓋厚度一百公分以上之阻水材料
q_en: What daily cover and final cover thicknesses apply to sanitary landfill operations?
a_en: At least 15 cm of sandy soil compacted at the end of each working day; at least 50 cm of impermeable material upon termination of use
b_en: At least 5 cm of sandy soil compacted at the end of each working day; at least 20 cm of impermeable material upon termination of use
c_en: At least 15 cm of sandy soil compacted at the end of each working week; at least 50 cm of impermeable material upon termination of use
d_en: At least 30 cm of sandy soil compacted at the end of each working day; at least 100 cm of impermeable material upon termination of use
explain_zh: 第30條第1項第2款：每日工作結束時應覆蓋厚度十五公分以上之砂土或同等效果封層劑並壓實，平坦面坡度百分之一以上。同項第4款：終止使用時應覆蓋厚度五十公分以上之砂質、泥質黏土、皂土或同等阻水材料，並綠化植被。第3款並規定每季定期檢測上下游地下水監測井水質。
explain_en: Article 30, paragraph 1, subparagraphs 2 and 4 require 15 cm daily cover and 50 cm final cover.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 灰渣採穩定化法處理後以衛生掩埋處理者，應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應運至專屬灰渣掩埋場，設置封閉掩埋單元並以抗壓材質構築，每月檢測滲出水之水質
b_zh: 應獨立分區掩埋，設置獨立滲出水收集系統並以雙層不透水材質構築，每季檢測相關水質
c_zh: 應與一般垃圾混合掩埋，設置共用滲出水收集系統並以單層黏土構築，每年檢測相關水質
d_zh: 應獨立分區掩埋，設置沼氣收集處理設施並以人造材質襯裡，每半年檢測地下水之水質
q_en: How must stabilized incineration ash be handled when placed in a sanitary landfill?
a_en: Transport to a dedicated ash landfill with a closed landfill cell built of pressure-resistant material, with monthly leachate testing
b_en: Landfill in an independent zone with an independent leachate collection system built of double impermeable material, with quarterly water testing
c_en: Landfill mixed with general garbage using a shared leachate collection system built of single-layer clay, with annual water testing
d_en: Landfill in an independent zone with biogas collection facilities and artificial lining material, with semi-annual groundwater testing
explain_zh: 第31條第1項第1款：灰渣採穩定化法處理後以衛生掩埋處理者，應獨立分區掩埋，設置獨立之滲出水收集系統及獨立分區設施，以雙層不透水材質構築，並設置間隔堤（牆）及防止滑動崩塌之設施。第2款：應每季定期檢測滲出水處理後及上下游地下水監測井水質，超標時一個月內提報因應措施。
explain_en: Article 31, paragraph 1 requires independent zoned landfill, an independent leachate system, double impermeable construction and quarterly testing.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 有害垃圾採封閉掩埋處理者，應適用何種規定？
a_zh: 準用事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之規定辦理
b_zh: 準用一般廢棄物掩埋場營運管理計畫所定之規定辦理
c_zh: 準用公民營廢棄物清除處理機構許可管理辦法之規定辦理
d_zh: 準用有害事業廢棄物認定標準所定之溶出試驗規定辦理
q_en: Which rules apply where hazardous garbage is placed in a closed landfill?
a_en: The Standards for Industrial Waste Storage, Clearance and Disposal Methods and Facilities apply mutatis mutandis
b_en: The operational management plan for general waste landfill sites applies mutatis mutandis
c_en: The Regulations Governing Permits for Public and Private Waste Institutions apply mutatis mutandis
d_en: The leaching test rules of the hazardous industrial waste identification standards apply mutatis mutandis
explain_zh: 第32條：有害垃圾採封閉掩埋處理者，準用事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之規定。第2條第22款並定義封閉掩埋法指將有害垃圾掩埋於以抗壓及雙層不透水材質所構築，並設有阻止污染物外洩及地下水監測裝置之處理方法。
explain_en: Article 32 applies the Standards for Industrial Waste Storage, Clearance and Disposal Methods and Facilities.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 掩埋場封場復育計畫應何時提出？封場後環境監測至少應執行幾年？
a_zh: 封場前三個月提出封場復育計畫報直轄市主管機關核准；封場後環境監測至少執行三年
b_zh: 封場前一年提出封場復育計畫報直轄市主管機關備查；封場後環境監測至少執行十年
c_zh: 封場後六個月提出封場復育計畫報中央主管機關核准；封場後環境監測至少執行五年
d_zh: 封場前六個月提出封場復育計畫報中央主管機關備查；封場後環境監測至少執行七年
q_en: When must a landfill closure and restoration plan be submitted, and for how long must post-closure monitoring run?
a_en: Submit the plan three months before closure to the municipal competent authority for approval; monitor for at least three years after closure
b_en: Submit the plan one year before closure to the municipal competent authority for recordation; monitor for at least ten years after closure
c_en: Submit the plan six months after closure to the central competent authority for approval; monitor for at least five years after closure
d_en: Submit the plan six months before closure to the central competent authority for recordation; monitor for at least seven years after closure
explain_zh: 第32條之1第1項：執行機關應於掩埋場封場前六個月提出封場復育計畫，報請中央主管機關備查並據以執行。第32條之2第1項規定監測項目應包含上下游地下水監測井水質及重金屬砷、鎘、鉻、銅、鉛、汞、鎳、鋅，每半年檢測一次；第3項規定封場後環境監測至少執行七年，最後二年連續符合規定者得申請終止。
explain_en: Article 32-1, paragraph 1 and Article 32-2, paragraph 3 set the six-month advance filing and the seven-year monitoring minimum.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 掩埋場封場復育計畫之地下水監測頻率及終止監測之條件為何？
a_zh: 上下游地下水監測井每半年檢測一次；監測至少七年且最後二年連續符合規定者得申請終止
b_zh: 上下游地下水監測井每季檢測一次；監測至少三年且最後一年連續符合規定者得申請終止
c_zh: 上下游地下水監測井每月檢測一次；監測至少十年且最後五年連續符合規定者得申請終止
d_zh: 上下游地下水監測井每年檢測一次；監測至少五年且最後三年連續符合規定者得申請終止
q_en: How often is groundwater monitored under a closure restoration plan, and when may monitoring end?
a_en: Up and down gradient wells are tested every six months; monitoring runs at least seven years and may end after two compliant final years
b_en: Up and down gradient wells are tested every quarter; monitoring runs at least three years and may end after one compliant final year
c_en: Up and down gradient wells are tested every month; monitoring runs at least ten years and may end after five compliant final years
d_en: Up and down gradient wells are tested every year; monitoring runs at least five years and may end after three compliant final years
explain_zh: 第32條之2第1項：封場復育計畫之環境監測類別應包含上下游地下水監測井水質，檢測項目包括砷、鎘、鉻、銅、鉛、汞、鎳及鋅，且每半年檢測一次。第3項：封場後環境監測至少執行七年，最後二年連續符合未處理滲出水低於放流水標準、地下水低於監測標準者，得報請中央主管機關同意後終止。
explain_en: Article 32-2 requires semi-annual testing, at least seven years of monitoring, and two consecutive compliant final years.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 掩埋場監測作業之執行紀錄應保存幾年？監測成果應於何時公開？
a_zh: 監測紀錄應妥善保存三年；監測成果應於取得結果之次季季底前由中央主管機關彙整後公告
b_zh: 監測紀錄應妥善保存一年；監測成果應於取得結果之次年年底前由執行機關函送議會備查
c_zh: 監測紀錄應妥善保存十年；監測成果應於取得結果之當月月底前由目的事業主管機關公開
d_zh: 監測紀錄應妥善保存五年；監測成果應於取得結果之次月月底前由地方主管機關登錄網站公開
q_en: How long are landfill monitoring records kept, and when are results published?
a_en: Records are kept for three years; results are compiled and announced by the central authority by the end of the following quarter
b_en: Records are kept for one year; results are sent by the executing agency to the council for recordation by the end of the next year
c_en: Records are kept for ten years; results are published by the industry competent authority by the end of the month they are obtained
d_en: Records are kept for five years; results are posted online by the local authority by the end of the month after they are obtained
explain_zh: 第32條之3第1項：第30條第1項第3款、第31條第1項第2款及第32條之2第1項之監測作業執行情形應作成紀錄，妥善保存五年。第2項：環境監測執行成果應於取得監測結果之次月月底前，由直轄市、縣（市）主管機關登錄於網站予以公開。
explain_en: Article 32-3 requires five-year retention and online publication by the local authority by the end of the following month.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 再利用機構對於一般廢棄物再利用之紀錄應如何辦理？
a_zh: 應按月作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存三年以供查核
b_zh: 應按日作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存一年以供查核
c_zh: 應按年作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存十年以供查核
d_zh: 應按季作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存五年以供查核
q_en: How must a reuse institution keep records of general waste reuse?
a_en: Make monthly records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for three years for inspection
b_en: Make daily records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for one year for inspection
c_en: Make annual records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for ten years for inspection
d_en: Make quarterly records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for five years for inspection
explain_zh: 第34條第3項：再利用機構對於一般廢棄物再利用之種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理，應按月作成紀錄，並妥善保存相關紀錄及證明文件三年，以供查核。第1項並規定再利用應依公告方式辦理或報經中央主管機關核准；第4項規定技術研發得專案向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請同意文件。
explain_en: Article 34, paragraph 3 requires monthly records kept for three years.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物採海洋棄置法處理者，應符合何種法律之規定？
a_zh: 應符合水污染防治法之規定辦理其海洋棄置作業
b_zh: 應符合海洋污染防治法之規定辦理其海洋棄置作業
c_zh: 應符合國土計畫法之規定辦理其海洋棄置之作業
d_zh: 應符合海岸管理法之規定辦理其海洋棄置之作業
q_en: Which Act governs the ocean dumping of general waste?
a_en: The Water Pollution Control Act governs the ocean dumping operation
b_en: The Marine Pollution Control Act governs the ocean dumping operation
c_en: The Spatial Planning Act governs the ocean dumping operation involved
d_en: The Coastal Zone Management Act governs the ocean dumping operation
explain_zh: 第35條：一般廢棄物採海洋棄置法處理者，應符合海洋污染防治法之規定。第2條第13款第2目並將海洋棄置列為最終處置方式之一。
explain_en: Article 35 requires compliance with the Marine Pollution Control Act.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 一般廢棄物之廢食用油輸出國外處理，應由何者申請許可？輸出對象有何限制？
a_zh: 由公民營廢棄物清除機構向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請許可，並以輸出至經濟合作暨發展組織會員國且具處理設施者為限
b_zh: 由公民營廢棄物處理機構向中央主管機關報請備查，並以輸出至亞太經濟合作會議會員經濟體且具處理設施者為限
c_zh: 由執行機關向中央主管機關申請輸出許可，並以輸出至世界貿易組織會員國且具有廢棄物處理設施之國家者為限
d_zh: 由回收處理業向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關報請核准，並以輸出至已簽署巴塞爾公約且具有處理設施之國家者為限
q_en: Who applies to export waste cooking oil from general waste, and to where may it be exported?
a_en: A public or private waste clearance institution applies to the municipal or county (city) authority; export is limited to OECD member states with treatment facilities
b_en: A public or private waste disposal institution reports to the central authority for recordation; export is limited to APEC member economies with treatment facilities
c_en: The executing agency applies to the central competent authority for an export permit; export is limited to World Trade Organization members with treatment facilities
d_en: A recycling and disposal enterprise reports to the municipal or county (city) authority; export is limited to Basel Convention parties with treatment facilities
explain_zh: 第35條之1第1項：一般廢棄物之廢食用油輸出國外處理，應由公民營廢棄物清除機構檢具貨品出口同意書申請書、接受國同意輸入文件、切結書等十一項文件，向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請許可，並以輸出至 OECD 會員國且具有處理設施者為限。第2項：廢食用油摻雜事業廢棄物者，應依本法第38條辦理。
explain_en: Article 35-1, paragraph 1 requires a clearance institution to apply to the local authority, with export limited to OECD members having treatment facilities.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 回收處理業回收貯存清除處理應回收廢棄物，其設施未符本辦法規定者應如何處理？
a_zh: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起三個月內完成改善其不符規定之設施
b_zh: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起一年內完成改善其不符規定之相關設施
c_zh: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起六個月內完成改善其不符規定之設施
d_zh: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起三年內完成改善其不符規定之相關設施
q_en: What deadline applies where a recycling enterprise's facilities do not meet these Regulations?
a_en: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within three months of the Regulations taking effect
b_en: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within one year of the amended Regulations taking effect
c_en: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within six months of the Regulations taking effect
d_en: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within three years of the amended Regulations taking effect
explain_zh: 第36條之1第1項：回收處理業回收貯存清除處理本法所定之應回收廢棄物，其設施未符合本辦法規定者，應於本辦法修正施行之日起一年內完成改善。第2項：修正施行前已完成建造、建造中、完成招標或已發包簽約之處理設施，不受第29條第1項第4款規定限制。
explain_en: Article 36-1, paragraph 1 gives one year from the effective date of the amendment.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應如何適用本辦法？
a_zh: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，得準用本辦法之規定辦理
b_zh: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應另依事業廢棄物規定辦理
c_zh: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應報中央主管機關核准
d_zh: 執行機關不得受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應由事業自行清理
q_en: How do these Regulations apply where an executing agency is entrusted with an enterprise's recyclable waste?
a_en: These Regulations apply mutatis mutandis to recyclable waste from enterprises cleared by the executing agency
b_en: Such recyclable waste must instead be handled under the separate rules that govern industrial waste
c_en: Such recyclable waste requires the prior approval of the central competent authority before any clearance
d_en: An executing agency may not accept such recyclable waste, which the generating enterprise must clear itself
explain_zh: 第37條：執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾得準用本辦法之規定。第6條第8項並規定執行機關受託處理一般事業廢棄物採焚化法、衛生掩埋法處理者，準用第19條、第24條、第29條及第30條規定。
explain_en: Article 37 allows these Regulations to apply mutatis mutandis.

law: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
q_zh: 本辦法之施行日期規定為何？
a_zh: 本辦法自發布後六個月施行
b_zh: 本辦法自公布後三個月施行
c_zh: 本辦法自發布後一年起施行
d_zh: 本辦法自發布日施行
q_en: When do these Regulations take effect?
a_en: These Regulations take effect six months after promulgation
b_en: These Regulations take effect three months after publication
c_en: These Regulations take effect one year after promulgation
d_en: These Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation
explain_zh: 第38條：本辦法自發布日施行。本辦法最近一次修正日期為民國一百十四年一月三日，其新增之第6條之2並就裝潢修繕廢棄物申報訂有分階段適用期程。
explain_en: Article 38 provides that the Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 《應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法》之訂定法源依據為何？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十五條第二項規定訂定之
b_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十六條第四項規定訂定之
c_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第十六條第四項規定訂定
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第十二條第一項規定訂定之
q_en: Under which provision are these Regulations enacted?
a_en: Enacted under Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Enacted under Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Waste Disposal Act
c_en: Enacted under Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Resource Recycling Act
d_en: Enacted under Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法（本法）第十六條第四項規定訂定之。本法第十五條第二項為應回收物品之公告依據，第十二條第一項則為一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法之授權依據。
explain_en: Article 1 cites Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Waste Disposal Act.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 本辦法所稱「責任物」之定義為何？
a_zh: 指經中央主管機關依本法第十六條第一項公告應設置回收設施之物品，及其銷售用之包裝與容器
b_zh: 指經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關公告應強制分類回收之一般廢棄物項目，及其製造使用之原料
c_zh: 指物品或其包裝、容器經中央主管機關依本法第十五條第二項公告者，及該物品或其包裝、容器之原料
d_zh: 指經目的事業主管機關認定具回收再利用價值之物品或容器，及其製造過程所使用之各項原料
q_en: How are responsibility goods defined under these Regulations?
a_en: Goods announced by the central authority under Article 16, paragraph 1 as requiring recycling facilities, plus their sales packaging
b_en: General waste items announced by the municipal or county (city) authority as subject to mandatory sorting, plus their raw materials
c_en: Goods or their packaging or containers announced by the central authority under Article 15, paragraph 2, and the raw materials of those items
d_en: Goods or containers recognized by the industry competent authority as having recycling value, plus the materials used to make them
explain_zh: 第2條第1款：責任物指物品或其包裝、容器經中央主管機關依本法第十五條第二項公告者，及該物品或其包裝、容器之原料。同條第2款定義營業量（製造業者為銷售量、容器商品製造業者為容器購入量及生產量等），第3款定義進口量。
explain_en: Article 2, subparagraph 1 covers announced goods, their packaging and containers, and the raw materials of those items.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者應於何時、向何機關申請登記？
a_zh: 應於首次製造或輸入責任物之次年一月底前，向中央主管機關報請備查
b_zh: 應於首次製造或輸入責任物之日起二個月內，向中央主管機關申請登記
c_zh: 應於首次製造或輸入責任物之日起三十日內，向所在地主管機關申請許可
d_zh: 應於首次製造或輸入責任物之日起六個月內，向所在地主管機關申請登記
q_en: When and to whom must a responsibility enterprise apply for registration?
a_en: Report to the central competent authority for recordation by the end of January of the following year
b_en: Apply to the central competent authority within two months of first manufacturing or importing responsibility goods
c_en: Apply to the local competent authority for a permit within thirty days of first manufacturing or importing goods
d_en: Apply to the local competent authority within six months of first manufacturing or importing responsibility goods
explain_zh: 第3條：責任業者應於首次製造或輸入責任物之日起二個月內，依其責任物項目，分別向中央主管機關申請登記。第4條並規定應檢具申請登記表、負責人身分證明文件影本及政府機關核准設立之證明文件影本等。違反第3條者依第17條，適用本法第51條第2項規定處罰。
explain_en: Article 3 requires registration with the central competent authority within two months of the first manufacture or import.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者完成登記後，負責人身分證明或設立證明文件有變更時應如何辦理？
a_zh: 負責人身分證明或設立證明文件變更者，應於變更後十五日內申請變更登記
b_zh: 負責人身分證明或設立證明文件變更者，應於變更後六個月內報請主管機關備查
c_zh: 負責人身分證明或設立證明文件變更者，應於變更當年年底前申請變更登記
d_zh: 負責人身分證明或設立證明文件變更者，應於變更後六十日內申請變更登記
q_en: How must a registered responsibility enterprise handle a change to its responsible person or establishment certificate?
a_en: Apply for change registration within fifteen days after the change of the identity or establishment certificate
b_en: Report to the competent authority for recordation within six months after the change occurred
c_en: Apply for change registration before the end of the calendar year in which the change occurred
d_en: Apply for change registration within sixty days after the change of the identity or establishment certificate
explain_zh: 第4條第2項：責任業者完成登記後，第1項第2款負責人身分證明文件或第3款政府機關核准設立證明文件之登記事項有變更者，應於變更後六十日內，檢具責任業者申請登記表及變更事項證明文件影本，向中央主管機關申請變更登記。違反者依第17條第1項處罰。
explain_en: Article 4, paragraph 2 requires change registration with the central authority within sixty days.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 容器本體來源標誌之免標示情形與標示方式規定為何？
a_zh: 本體重量未達一百公克或表面已標示回收標誌之容器者得免標示；圖樣邊長至少應達一點五公分
b_zh: 本體表面積未達五十平方公分或屬回收再生材質製成之容器者得免標示；圖樣邊長至少應達零點五公分
c_zh: 本體表面積未達二百平方公分或屬僅供國內銷售用容器者得免標示；圖樣邊長至少應達三公分以上
d_zh: 本體表面積未達一百平方公分或表面材質特殊無法標示並經同意者得免標示；圖樣邊長至少應達一點五公分
q_en: When is the container source mark exempt, and what marking specification applies?
a_en: Exempt if the body weighs under 100 grams or the surface already bears a recycling logo; the side length of the mark is at least 1.5 cm
b_en: Exempt if the body surface area is under 50 square centimetres or the container is made of recycled material; the side length of the mark is at least 0.5 cm
c_en: Exempt if the body surface area is under 200 square centimetres or the container is sold only domestically; the side length of the mark is at least 3 cm
d_en: Exempt if the body surface area is under 100 square centimetres or special surface material prevents marking with authority consent; the mark side is at least 1.5 cm
explain_zh: 第4條之1第2項：紙製平板容器本體表面積未達一百平方公分或因表面材質特殊無法標示，並提供本體樣本經中央主管機關同意者，或供輸出者，得免標示容器本體來源標誌。第3項第2款：圖樣邊長至少應達一點五公分，紙製平板容器應顯著標示於本體，商品則標示於容器、包裝或標籤。
explain_en: Article 4-1, paragraphs 2 and 3 set the 100 square centimetre exemption and the 1.5 cm minimum side length.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者停止製造、輸入責任物者得如何辦理？經廢止登記後有何效果？
a_zh: 得檢具廢止登記申請表等文件申請廢止登記；經廢止登記者免依本辦法辦理申報及繳費
b_zh: 應於停止之日起三年內維持登記不得廢止；該期間仍應依規定辦理申報及繳費作業
c_zh: 應報請所在地主管機關備查後自動失其登記效力；並得就已繳費用申請全額之退還
d_zh: 得檢具停業證明文件申請暫停列管一年；暫停期間仍應按期辦理申報但得免予繳費
q_en: What may a responsibility enterprise do when it stops manufacturing or importing, and what follows from deregistration?
a_en: Apply for deregistration with the application form and related documents; once deregistered it need not declare or pay under these Regulations
b_en: Maintain the registration for three years from stopping without deregistering, and continue to declare and pay during that period
c_en: Report to the local competent authority for recordation, whereupon registration lapses automatically and all fees paid may be refunded
d_en: Apply for a one-year suspension of control with a business suspension certificate; it must still declare on time but is exempt from payment
explain_zh: 第5條第1項：責任業者停止製造、輸入責任物或有其他經認定免予列管情形者，得檢具廢止登記申請表（含切結聲明）、負責人身分證明文件影本、停工停業歇業或廢止公司登記證明文件影本等，向中央主管機關申請廢止登記。第3項：經廢止登記者免依本辦法辦理申報、繳費；恢復製造輸入者應重新辦理登記、申報及繳費。
explain_en: Article 5 allows deregistration on application, after which declaration and payment obligations cease.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者繳納回收清除處理費及申報營業量之期限與期間為何？
a_zh: 於每單月十日前繳納回收清除處理費，並申報前六個月之營業量或進口量
b_zh: 於每雙月十五日前繳納回收清除處理費，並申報前一個月之營業量或進口量
c_zh: 於每季首月月底前繳納回收清除處理費，並申報前三個月之營業量或進口量
d_zh: 於每單月三十日前繳納回收清除處理費，並申報前二個月之營業量或進口量
q_en: What is the deadline and period for paying the recycling fee and declaring volumes?
a_en: Pay the recycling, clearance and disposal fee by the 10th of each odd month and declare the volumes of the preceding six months
b_en: Pay the recycling, clearance and disposal fee by the 15th of each even month and declare the volumes of the preceding one month
c_en: Pay the recycling, clearance and disposal fee by the end of the first month of each quarter and declare the preceding three months
d_en: Pay the recycling, clearance and disposal fee by the 30th of each odd month and declare the volumes of the preceding two months
explain_zh: 第6條第1項：責任業者應自中央主管機關公告應負回收、清除、處理責任之日起，於每單月三十日前，依前二個月營業量或進口量及核定費率繳納回收清除處理費。第2項並規定同期限內檢具申報表及繳費證明申報前二個月營業量；第10條規定應以網路傳輸方式申報。
explain_en: Article 6 requires payment and declaration by the 30th of each odd month covering the preceding two months.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 中央主管機關核定查定營業量之適用情形及免徵門檻為何？
a_zh: 連續五年內每年應繳納回收清除處理費未達新臺幣十萬元者；查定應繳金額為新臺幣六百元以下者免徵
b_zh: 連續三年內每年應繳納回收清除處理費未達新臺幣五萬元者；查定應繳金額為新臺幣三千元以下者免徵
c_zh: 連續二年內每年應繳納回收清除處理費未達新臺幣十萬元者；查定應繳金額為新臺幣一千二百元以下免徵
d_zh: 連續二年內每年應繳納回收清除處理費未達新臺幣一百萬元者；查定應繳金額為新臺幣一萬元以下免徵
q_en: When may the central authority assess volumes, and what amount is exempt from collection?
a_en: Where the annual fee for five consecutive years is under NT$100,000; assessed amounts of NT$600 or less are exempt from collection
b_en: Where the annual fee for three consecutive years is under NT$50,000; assessed amounts of NT$3,000 or less are exempt from collection
c_en: Where the annual fee for two consecutive years is under NT$100,000; assessed amounts of NT$1,200 or less are exempt from collection
d_en: Where the annual fee for two consecutive years is under NT$1,000,000; assessed amounts of NT$10,000 or less are exempt from collection
explain_zh: 第7條第1項第1款：連續二年內每年應繳納之回收清除處理費未達新臺幣十萬元者，中央主管機關得核定首年查定之營業量或進口量。第3項：依查定計算年度應繳費用，未達完整年度者依比率計；應繳納金額為新臺幣一千二百元以下者免徵。第8條並規定查核年度差異超過新臺幣五萬元以上者應自行申報繳費。
explain_en: Article 7, paragraph 1, subparagraph 1 and paragraph 3 set the NT$100,000 threshold and NT$1,200 exemption.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者採用查定營業量或進口量後，於何種情形應改依規定自行申報、繳費？
a_zh: 負責人或公司登記地址有所變更，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣一千二百元者
b_zh: 責任物項目增加或減少一項以上，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣一百萬元以上
c_zh: 營業狀況變動致與查定量有些微差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五十萬元者
d_zh: 營業狀況變動致與查定量有重大差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五萬元以上者
q_en: When must an enterprise using assessed volumes switch back to declaring and paying on its own?
a_en: Where the responsible person or the registered company address changes, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$1,200
b_en: Where the number of responsibility goods items rises or falls by one or more, or an audit shows a difference over NT$1,000,000
c_en: Where changed business conditions differ slightly from the assessed volume, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$500,000
d_en: Where changed business conditions differ materially from the assessed volume, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$50,000
explain_zh: 第8條第1項：責任業者採用查定營業量或進口量後，其營業狀況變動致與查定量有重大差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五萬元以上者，應依第6條或第9條規定自行申報、繳費。第2項：經查核有短漏者，應令其補繳短漏金額。
explain_en: Article 8, paragraph 1 applies where there is a material difference or an audited annual difference over NT$50,000.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者於何種情形得申請改為一年申報繳費一次？其申報繳費期限為何？
a_zh: 前六期應繳費用累計未達新臺幣十萬元者得申請改為一年一次，並於每年一月三十日前申報繳費
b_zh: 前三期應繳費用累計未達新臺幣五十萬元者得申請改為半年一次，並於每年六月三十日前申報繳費
c_zh: 前一年應繳費用累計未達新臺幣二十萬元者得申請改為一年一次，並於每年十二月底前申報繳費
d_zh: 前六期應繳費用累計未達新臺幣一萬元者得申請改為一年一次，並於每年三月三十日前申報繳費
q_en: When may a responsibility enterprise switch to annual declaration and payment, and by when must it file?
a_en: Where fees for the previous six periods total under NT$100,000, it may switch to once a year and must file and pay by 30 January each year
b_en: Where fees for the previous three periods total under NT$500,000, it may switch to twice a year and must file and pay by 30 June each year
c_en: Where fees for the previous year total under NT$200,000, it may switch to once a year and must file and pay by the end of December each year
d_en: Where fees for the previous six periods total under NT$10,000, it may switch to once a year and must file and pay by 30 March each year
explain_zh: 第9條第1項：責任業者前六期應繳納之回收清除處理費累計未達新臺幣十萬元者，得以網路傳輸方式申請將申報、繳費頻率改為一年一次。第2項：經同意者應於每年一月三十日前申報繳費。第3項：前一年度應繳費用達新臺幣十萬元以上者，應於當年三月三十日前依第6條規定申報、繳費。
explain_en: Article 9, paragraphs 1 and 2 allow annual filing below NT$100,000 for six periods, due by 30 January.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者營業量或進口量之申報，應以何種方式為之？
a_zh: 應以書面方式向所在地主管機關遞送申報表並檢附發票影本；經同意者得改以網路申報
b_zh: 應以電子郵件方式向中央主管機關指定信箱申報並附繳費證明；不得使用網路申報系統
c_zh: 應以網路傳輸方式向中央主管機關網路申報系統申報並免檢具申報表；經同意者得書面申報
d_zh: 應以網路傳輸方式向所在地主管機關申報並同時檢具申報表；不得以任何方式改為書面
q_en: How must business or import volumes be declared?
a_en: In writing to the local competent authority with the declaration form and invoice copies; online filing is allowed only with consent
b_en: By email to a mailbox designated by the central authority with payment proof; the online declaration system may not be used
c_en: Online through the central authority's declaration system with no paper form required; a written filing is allowed only with consent
d_en: Online to the local competent authority together with the declaration form; a written filing is not permitted under any circumstances
explain_zh: 第10條：營業量或進口量之申報，應以網路傳輸方式向中央主管機關網路申報系統申報，免檢具責任物之營業量或進口量申報表；但報經中央主管機關同意以書面申報者，不在此限。第9條第1項之申請改為一年一次申報，亦應以網路傳輸方式為之。
explain_en: Article 10 requires online declaration to the central authority's system, with written filing only by consent.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者製造或輸入之責任物不在國內廢棄者，得如何辦理？
a_zh: 得檢具申報表及委外處理契約等文件，經目的事業主管機關核准後免除其全部之繳費責任
b_zh: 得檢具申報表及銷售發票影本等文件，向所在地主管機關申請退還已繳納之回收清除處理費
c_zh: 得檢具申報表及不在國內廢棄之證明文件等，經中央主管機關認定後扣抵其營業量或進口量
d_zh: 得檢具申報表及出口報單影本等文件，逕行自行扣抵其營業量或進口量並免報中央主管機關
q_en: What may an enterprise do where its responsibility goods are not discarded domestically?
a_en: File the declaration form with an outsourced treatment contract and be relieved of all payment duties once the industry authority approves
b_en: File the declaration form with copies of sales invoices and apply to the local authority for a refund of the fees already paid
c_en: File the declaration form with documents proving non-domestic discard and deduct the volume once the central authority recognizes it
d_en: File the declaration form with copies of export declarations and deduct the volume directly without reporting to the central authority
explain_zh: 第11條第1項：責任業者製造或輸入之責任物不在國內廢棄或使用後不產生廢棄物者，得檢具營業量或進口量申報表、不在國內廢棄或使用後不產生廢棄物之證明文件、不在國內廢棄之扣抵量彙總表等，經中央主管機關認定後扣抵其營業量或進口量。第2項：第7條第1項之責任業者不適用之。
explain_en: Article 11, paragraph 1 allows deduction after recognition by the central competent authority.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者得申請分期繳納回收清除處理費之原因為何？利息如何計算？
a_zh: 因訂單減少導致營運週轉困難，或經查核應補繳費用達新臺幣一萬元以上者，得分期並免計利息
b_zh: 因天然災害等不可歸責事由受重大財產損失，或經查核應補繳達新臺幣十萬元以上，按日複利計息
c_zh: 因負責人變更尚未完成登記手續，或經查核應補繳費用達新臺幣五十萬元以上，按月計算利息
d_zh: 因原料價格大幅上漲致成本增加，或經查核應補繳費用達新臺幣一百萬元以上，得延期一年繳清
q_en: On what grounds may fees be paid in instalments, and how is interest computed?
a_en: Operating difficulty caused by falling orders, or audited arrears of NT$10,000 or more, in which case instalments carry no interest at all
b_en: Major property loss from a natural disaster or other non-attributable cause, or audited arrears of NT$100,000 or more, with daily compound interest
c_en: An incomplete change registration of the responsible person, or audited arrears of NT$500,000 or more, with interest computed monthly
d_en: A sharp rise in raw material prices raising costs, or audited arrears of NT$1,000,000 or more, with a one-year deferral of payment
explain_zh: 第12條：責任業者因颱風、地震、水災、土石流或其他天然災害或不可歸責之事由致遭受重大財產損失，或經主管機關查核應補繳回收清除處理費達新臺幣十萬元以上者，得於繳納期限前檢具分期繳納申請表及證明文件，向中央主管機關申請按郵政儲金匯業局一年期定期存款利率按日複利計算利息分期繳納。
explain_en: Article 12 allows instalments for disaster losses or audited arrears of NT$100,000 or more, with daily compound interest.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 平板容器銷售予容器商品製造業者之量，其製造或輸入業者得如何辦理？
a_zh: 得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及銷售發票，申報扣抵其營業量或進口量
b_zh: 得檢具銷售契約書及進貨統一發票，申請免辦理該期之申報及繳費
c_zh: 得檢具銷售對象名冊及庫存盤點表，申請延期繳納該期之處理費用
d_zh: 得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及出口報單，申請退還已繳納之處理費用
q_en: What may a flat container manufacturer or importer do for volumes sold to container-goods manufacturers?
a_en: File a deduction summary of sales volume with sales invoices and deduct the amount from its business or import volume
b_en: File the sales contract and purchase invoices and apply to be exempt from declaring and paying for that period
c_en: File a list of buyers and an inventory count sheet and apply to defer payment of the fee for that period
d_en: File a deduction summary of sales volume with export declarations and apply for a refund of the fees already paid
explain_zh: 第13條第1項：平板容器或非平板類免洗餐具銷售予容器商品製造業者之量，平板容器製造或輸入業者、非平板類免洗餐具製造或輸入業者得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及銷售發票申報扣抵其營業量或進口量。第2項就生質塑膠原料及平板容器板材另有類似規定；第3項規定第7條第1項之責任業者不適用。
explain_en: Article 13, paragraph 1 allows deduction on filing a sales deduction summary and sales invoices.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者溢繳回收清除處理費者得如何辦理？其退費金額有何限制？
a_zh: 得向所在地主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以當年度已繳納金額之半數為上限
b_zh: 得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以責任業者已繳納之總金額為其上限
c_zh: 得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以新臺幣十萬元為其上限不得超過
d_zh: 得向指定之金融機構申請退費，但退費總金額以前六期已繳納金額合計為上限
q_en: How may an overpaid recycling fee be recovered, and what limit applies?
a_en: Apply to the local competent authority for a refund, capped at half of the amount paid during the current year
b_en: Apply to the central competent authority for a refund, capped at the total amount the enterprise has already paid
c_en: Apply to the central competent authority for a refund, capped at NT$100,000 which may not be exceeded
d_en: Apply to the designated financial institution for a refund, capped at the total paid over the previous six periods
explain_zh: 第14條第1項：責任業者溢繳之回收清除處理費，得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以責任業者已繳納之總金額為限。第2項：退費依第11條及第13條檢具文件或銷售發票所載日期對應之費率計算；可證明扣抵量原申報繳費日期者，以原申報繳費日期對應費率計算。
explain_en: Article 14, paragraph 1 permits refunds from the central authority, capped at the total already paid.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者提供之資料不實或未提供完整帳冊時，主管機關如何認定其營業量或進口量？
a_zh: 依銷售額相近同業平均營業量之三倍計算，作為該責任業者當期之營業量或進口量並據以計費
b_zh: 依上年度申報之營業量加計百分之二十，作為該責任業者當期之營業量或進口量認定之基準
c_zh: 依原（物）料、人員、水電或設備使用情形等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最低營業量或進口量
d_zh: 依原（物）料、人員、水電或設備使用情形等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最高營業量或進口量
q_en: How does the authority determine volumes where an enterprise gives false data or incomplete books?
a_en: Multiply by three the average volume of peers with similar turnover and use that as the current period's volume for the fee
b_en: Add twenty percent to the volume declared for the previous year and use that as the basis for the current period's volume
c_en: Adopt the lowest volume obtainable among six prescribed methods based on materials, staff, utilities, equipment use and similar data
d_en: Adopt the highest volume obtainable among six prescribed methods based on materials, staff, utilities, equipment use and similar data
explain_zh: 第15條第1項：主管機關或其委託之專業人員依本法第20條查核時，責任業者所提供資料不實或未提供完整帳冊者，得依原（物）料人員水電設備使用情形、上下游業者資料、銷售額相近同業申報量、同業費額占銷售額比例、相近同業製造量計算方式、稅捐機關提供資料等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最高營業量或進口量。
explain_en: Article 15, paragraph 1 requires choosing the highest obtainable volume among the six listed methods.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者之營業量申報表、繳費證明及扣抵證明文件應保存幾年？
a_zh: 營業量或進口量申報表、回收清除處理費繳費證明及扣抵證明文件，應保存五年備查
b_zh: 營業量或進口量申報表、回收清除處理費繳費證明及扣抵證明文件，應保存三年備查
c_zh: 營業量或進口量申報表、回收清除處理費繳費證明及扣抵證明文件，應保存一年備查
d_zh: 營業量或進口量申報表、回收清除處理費繳費證明及扣抵證明文件，應保存十年備查
q_en: How long must declaration forms, payment certificates and deduction documents be kept?
a_en: Declaration forms of business or import volume, fee payment certificates and deduction documents shall be kept for five years
b_en: Declaration forms of business or import volume, fee payment certificates and deduction documents shall be kept for one year
c_en: Declaration forms of business or import volume, fee payment certificates and deduction documents shall be kept for three years
d_en: Declaration forms of business or import volume, fee payment certificates and deduction documents shall be kept for ten years
explain_zh: 第16條：責任業者之營業量或進口量申報表、回收清除處理費繳費證明及扣抵證明文件，應保存五年備查。第17條第1項規定違反第16條者，依本法第51條第2項規定處罰。第15條並規定查核時資料不實或未提供完整帳冊者，主管機關得以六種方法擇定最高營業量認定。
explain_en: Article 16 requires five-year retention; Article 17 makes a violation punishable under Article 51, paragraph 2 of the Act.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 責任業者違反登記、變更登記、申報或繳費等規定者，依何規定處罰？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第三十一條第五項規定處罰
b_zh: 依資源回收再利用法第二十六條規定處罰
c_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第五十一條第二項規定處罰
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第五十八條之規定予以處罰
q_en: Under which provision is a responsibility enterprise punished for registration, declaration or payment violations?
a_en: Punished under Article 31, paragraph 5 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Punished under Article 26 of the Resource Recycling and Reuse Act
c_en: Punished under Article 51, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
d_en: Punished under Article 58 of the Waste Disposal Act as applicable
explain_zh: 第17條第1項：違反第3條、第4條第2項、第4條之1第1項、第3項、第5條第3項、第6條、第9條第2項、第3項或第16條規定者，依本法第51條第2項規定處罰。第2項並規定營業量及進口量為零、已申請廢止登記或有第8條第1項情形者，應於指定期限內申報繳費，逾期仍依同條項處罰。
explain_en: Article 17 applies Article 51, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

law: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
q_zh: 本辦法及其一百十三年十二月十六日修正條文之施行日期為何？
a_zh: 本辦法自一百十年一月一日施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自一百十五年一月一日施行
b_zh: 本辦法自發布日起施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自發布後滿六個月之日起開始施行
c_zh: 本辦法自一百零九年一月一日施行；修正發布之全部條文自一百十四年七月一日起施行
d_zh: 本辦法自一百零九年七月一日施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自一百十四年一月一日施行
q_en: When did these Regulations and the amendments of 16 December 2024 take effect?
a_en: The Regulations took effect on 1 January 2021; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect on 1 January 2026
b_en: The Regulations took effect on promulgation; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect six months after promulgation
c_en: The Regulations took effect on 1 January 2020; all amended provisions took effect on 1 July 2025 as a whole
d_en: The Regulations took effect on 1 July 2020; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect on 1 January 2025
explain_zh: 第18條第1項：本辦法自中華民國一百零九年七月一日施行。第2項：本辦法修正條文，除中華民國一百十三年十二月十六日修正發布之第7條及第8條自一百十四年一月一日施行外，自發布日施行。第7條、第8條即查定營業量之相關規定。
explain_en: Article 18 sets 1 July 2020 for the Regulations and 1 January 2025 for the amended Articles 7 and 8.

law: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
q_zh: 《事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則》之訂定法源依據為何？
a_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第三十一條第一項規定訂定之
b_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第二十八條第二項規定訂定之
c_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第三十九條第二項規定訂定之
d_zh: 依廢棄物清理法第三十條第二項規定訂定之
q_en: Under which provision are these Criteria enacted?
a_en: Enacted under Article 31, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
b_en: Enacted under Article 28, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
c_en: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
d_en: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
explain_zh: 第1條：本準則依廢棄物清理法（本法）第三十條第二項規定訂定之。本法第二十八條為事業廢棄物清理方式之規定，第三十一條為公告事業之清理計畫書及申報義務，第三十九條第二項則為再利用管理辦法之授權依據。
explain_en: Article 1 cites Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

law: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
category: 相當注意義務-自主稽核
q_zh: 應置廢棄物專業技術人員之事業，其內部自主巡察稽核制度應如何辦理？
a_zh: 每季定期巡察稽核，作成巡察稽核紀錄，並追蹤缺失改善情形納入自主稽核重點
b_zh: 每年定期巡察稽核，作成巡察稽核紀錄，並送當地主管機關審查核定後始生效力
c_zh: 每半年定期巡察稽核，作成巡察稽核紀錄，並將稽核紀錄公開於事業網站供查閱
d_zh: 每月定期巡察稽核，作成巡察稽核紀錄，並將缺失逕行通報中央主管機關列管
q_en: How must an enterprise required to appoint waste technicians run its internal audit system?
a_en: Conduct scheduled internal audits every quarter, make audit records, and track corrections as a focus of later audits
b_en: Conduct scheduled internal audits every year, make audit records, and submit them to the local authority for approval
c_en: Conduct scheduled internal audits every half year, make audit records, and publish the records on the enterprise website
d_en: Conduct scheduled internal audits every month, make audit records, and report deficiencies directly to the central authority
explain_zh: 第2條第5款：事業應建立內部自主巡察稽核廢棄物制度，包括每季定期巡察稽核、作成巡察稽核紀錄、追蹤缺失改善情形並納入自主巡察稽核重點。第8款規定該紀錄應向事業負責人或其授權之人提出報告，並妥善保存五年。
explain_en: Article 2, subparagraph 5 requires quarterly internal audits, written records, and follow-up on deficiencies.

law: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
q_zh: 事業對收受附表二廢棄物之受託者，查訪頻率及例外規定為何？
a_zh: 每年至少一次查訪收受附表二廢棄物之受託者並作成紀錄，公有公營或公有民營焚化廠受託者除外
b_zh: 每二年至少一次查訪收受附表一廢棄物之受託者並作成紀錄，民營廢棄物處理機構之受託者除外
c_zh: 每月至少一次查訪收受附表二廢棄物之受託者並作成紀錄，已取得再利用許可之受託者則得免查訪
d_zh: 每季至少一次查訪收受附表二廢棄物之受託者並作成紀錄，公有公營或公有民營焚化廠受託者亦同
